purpose: Converts the holdout's free-text distress_type labels into the extractor's fixed values (src/extract/schema.py DISTRESS_TYPES). Written by Claude Code on 2026-11-10 from the labels alone, before any model output was seen; review it.
rule: Correct when the prediction contains every 'required' value and nothing outside required + allowed. 'any_of' = at least one of these counts as the required value.
negatives_rule: N16-N20: label distress NOT FOUND. Strict view: prediction must be NOT FOUND. Pipeline view: 'sale' / 'operator_change' alone is a market sale (Gate 3 decision #4: not distress), so it also counts as NOT FOUND. Pass/fail uses the pipeline view; both are reported.

H01.note: label 'bankruptcy', chapter not stated (soft chapter_11); sale closed

H04.note: sheriff's sale; lender took the property

H08.note: receivership suit dropped; broker marketing the property

H10.note: SCHEMA GAP: the extractor has no delayed_opening value, so this field cannot be correct until the enum is extended

H12.note: 'never opened' = delayed opening (schema gap; allowed, not required)
